name: oyster-woocommerce
description: Development tooling only. The plugin ships no JavaScript build — assets/js is plain, hand-written script served as-is.

scripts.env:prepare: wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin install woocommerce
scripts.test:integration: npm run env:prepare && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/oyster-woocommerce ./vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml
